name: uart-capture
description:
We tapped a serial line with a logic analyzer and dumped the samples to `capture.csv`. Each row is one time step: `time_ns` is the timestamp, and `d0_uart` and `d1_refclk` are the levels on the two probes we clipped on. Somewhere on that line a short ASCII message was transmitted.

Recover the message. The flag is the transmitted text.

Stuck? Hints are available (they cost a few points).

Flag format: NCTF{...}
